exposure: Previous cervical excision surgery (LLETZ or conization)
cohort: 20 women with previous cervical excision surgery who underwent pre-pregnancy abdominal cerclage and had 26 pregnancies over a 10-year period
finding: Prophylactic minimally invasive transabdominal cerclage in women with previous LLETZ or cone biopsy resulted in a high live birth rate (84.6%) and a 12% premature delivery rate.
mod_finding: All 25 women who delivered were delivered by Caesarean section.
